items.text: When individual desires conflict with group needs:

options.A: Individual needs should usually take priority
options.B: Individual needs often take priority with exceptions
options.C: Neither has inherent priority—it's entirely situational
options.D: Group needs often take priority with exceptions
options.E: Group needs should usually take priority

items.text: A talented person has an opportunity that benefits them but harms their community. They should:

options.A: Take the opportunity—individuals must pursue their own path
options.B: Probably take it, while weighing community impact
options.C: Carefully weigh both factors with no presumption
options.D: Probably stay, while weighing personal cost

options.A: A virtue—self-reliance is admirable and productive
options.C: A mixed bag—valuable but can be taken too far
options.E: A mask for selfishness that harms community
